Dear Stijn,

I am writing to apply for the Performance Marketeer position at Introw. As a junior digital marketer with a strong technical foundation in SEO, GEO, and web analytics, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your growth journey.

At Episto, I manage on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and WordPress site builds, using tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to drive organic visibility. I would love to discuss how I can contribute to your team. Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Stijn,

I am excited to apply for the Performance Marketeer role at Introw. Your mission to transform partnerships into revenue engines resonates deeply with me, as I have always been passionate about leveraging technology and data to drive growth.

With a background in digital marketing and a technical foundation in web development, I bring a unique blend of skills that align with your needs. At Episto, I have honed my abilities in on-page SEO, content strategy, and WordPress site management, using analytics tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to make data-driven decisions. I have also gained hands-on experience with Google Ads, which has sparked my interest in paid acquisition.

My entrepreneurial spirit is evident in my project mirook.com, where I designed and built a WordPress site from scratch, implemented structured data (JSON-LD), and conducted iterative SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project taught me to take ownership, move fast, and build things from scratch—qualities I know are essential at Introw.

While my experience is primarily in organic growth, I am eager to expand into paid channels and ABM. I am comfortable with Google Ads and quick to learn new tools like Clay and Lemlist. I am particularly drawn to the opportunity to work with buyer intent data and power smart outbound, as I enjoy turning signals into actionable strategies.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am available for full-time work. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level and improving.

I would love to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can contribute to Introw's growth. Thank you for considering my application.

Warm regards,

Baver Ok

Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- Performance Marketing: Google Ads, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & Build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

## Projects

- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO)
